description: Search the public WIA Music catalog of original K-pop / K-trot / K-ballad songs (each sold as a 1-of-1 bundle with sheet music). Filter by text, genre, musical key, BPM range, or available score formats. Read-only; purchasing is done on the website. For copyright screening of arbitrary audio use the Music Check MCP.
